:::{#def-chance-agreement}
#### Chance agreement

Let:

- $A$ be the [event](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-event) that the agent makes a [positive classification](#def-positive-classification)
  for an observation drawn from a [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population),
  with [complement](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-complement) $\neg A$.
- $R$ be the event that the reference makes a positive classification for the same observation, with complement $\neg R$.

The **chance agreement** of the agent and the reference on that population
is the [overall agreement](#def-overall-agreement) they would have
if $A$ and $R$ were [statistically independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt)
with their marginal [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $\Prf{A}$ and $\Prf{R}$:

$$p_e \eqdef \Prf{A} \cd \Prf{R} + \Prf{\neg A} \cd \Prf{\neg R}$$ {#eq-chance-agreement}

Source: @cohen1960coefficient.

:::
